set-variable.value:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/java
var remoteAddress = (attributes.remoteAddress default "") as String
var cleanIp = if (remoteAddress == "") null else ((remoteAddress replace "/" with "") splitBy ":")[0]
--- vars.auditContext default { startTimeMs: now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"},
attributes: { headers: { systemId: attributes.headers.systemid default attributes.headers.SYSTEMID default null,
source: attributes.headers.source default attributes.headers.SOURCE default null,
contentType: attributes.headers.'content-type' default attributes.headers.'Content-Type' default null,
accept: attributes.headers.accept default attributes.headers.Accept default null,
userAgent: attributes.headers.'user-agent' default attributes.headers.'User-Agent' default null },
queryParams: attributes.queryParams default {} },
host: attributes.headers.host default attributes.headers.Host default null,
correlationId: attributes.headers.'X-CORRELATION-ID' default attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default null,
apiName: app.name default null,
processName: (attributes.method default "") ++ " " ++ (attributes.requestPath default ""),
path: attributes.requestPath default null,
httpMethod: attributes.method default null,
ip: attributes.headers.'x-forwarded-for' default attributes.headers.'X-Forwarded-For' default cleanIp }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Audit Context
